title: 第一部分 基础训练 TEST 5

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Tea is a popular drink in China. Many people may feel uncomfortable if they don't have it. Chinese tea has a long history going back more than 5,000 years. Over 1,000 years ago, a famous person wrote a book about tea. Its name is *The Classic of Tea*.

Today, China has many different kinds of tea: white, yellow, green, oolong, and black tea. People in different places have different tea drinking habits. People in Guangdong and Fujian love gongfu tea in small teacups. People in Beijing like flowering tea. In Lhasa, people like to drink buttered tea(酥油茶) to keep healthy.

There is an important rule of making tea for friends. It's not good to make the cup full (满的), because the cup will be too hot for people to hold.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT true according to Paragraph 1?
options: The history of tea is very long.
A lot of Chinese people love drinking tea.
The Classic of Tea was written 5,000 years ago.
questions.translation: 根据第一段，下列哪项是不正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“Over 1,000 years ago, a famous person wrote a book about tea. Its name is The Classic of Tea.”可知，《茶经》写于1000多年前，而不是5000年前。因此答案为D。

questions.prompt: What kind of tea do people in Guangdong love?
questions.translation: 广东人喜欢什么茶？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“People in Guangdong and Fujian love gongfu tea in small teacups.”可知，广东和福建人喜欢功夫茶（Gongfu tea）。答案为A。

questions.prompt: Why do the people in Lhasa love buttered tea?
questions.translation: 拉萨人为什么喜欢喝酥油茶？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“In Lhasa, people like to drink buttered tea to keep healthy.”可知，喝酥油茶是为了保持健康（To stay healthy）。答案为C。

questions.prompt: What does Paragraph 2 mainly talk about?
options: The rule of making tea for friends.
Different kinds of tea and drinking habits.
questions.translation: 第二段主要讲了什么？
questions.explanation: 第二段介绍了中国茶的不同种类（white, yellow, green...）以及不同地区人们的饮茶习惯。因此答案为D。

questions.prompt: What is the rule of making tea for friends?
options: Don't make the tea too hot.
questions.translation: 给朋友沏茶的规则是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“It's not good to make the cup full, because the cup will be too hot for people to hold.”可知，杯子不能倒满（Don't make the cup full）。因此答案为B。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Sameer Jani is a five-year-old kid. He likes tennis, animals, and reading. "I read a lot of books," said Sameer. He even wrote four children's books.

Sameer's love for books, animals and tennis makes him write books. "The first book was about an alligator(短吻鳄) named Chocovella," said Sameer's mother Zalina Jani. "The little alligator liked playing tennis very much. But he had a hard time playing one of his games. When he wanted to give up, his coach told him never to give up. To keep trying, he told himself, 'I can do it'. And finally he did it."

Sameer said, "Chocovella is a good example for kids because he didn't give up when he met difficulties."

Now all of his four books can be bought on the Internet. And his books are all about Florida animals modeled after(仿照) himself.

questions.prompt: How many children's books did Sameer write?
questions.translation: 萨米尔写了几本童书？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段最后一句“He even wrote four children's books.”可知，他写了四本童书。答案为C。

questions.prompt: Who is Zalina Jani?
questions.translation: 扎利娜·贾尼是谁？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“said Sameer's mother Zalina Jani”可知，她是萨米尔的妈妈。答案为B。

questions.prompt: What can we know from Sameer's first book?
options: A boy was interested in playing tennis.
An alligator liked reading books and writing.
A boy played tennis well with his coach's help.
An alligator didn't give up when he met difficulties.
questions.translation: 从萨米尔的第一本书中我们能了解到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段和第三段“Chocovella is a good example for kids because he didn't give up when he met difficulties.”可知，短吻鳄遇到困难时没有放弃。答案为D。

questions.prompt: What are Sameer's children's books about?
questions.translation: 萨米尔的童书是关于什么的？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一句“And his books are all about Florida animals modeled after himself.”可知，是以他为原型塑造的佛罗里达动物的故事。答案为C。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
John liked to run, but he wasn't very good at it. One day, he decided to join a marathon(马拉松赛跑). He practiced a lot, but on the race day, he felt worried.

When the race started, John couldn't run as fast as others. His legs hurt, and he wanted to stop. Just when John wanted to give up, he saw a man running without shoes. The man's clothes were old, but he seemed to be happy and enjoying the race. John was encouraged(鼓舞) by the man, so he kept running.

As they got close to the finish line, John tried his best and ran past the man. He <u>beat</u> the man. Tired but happy, John turned to the man and asked, "You were amazing! How did you run so well without shoes?"

The man smiled and said, "I deliver(递送) pizzas every day. Running a marathon was easy for me!"

questions.prompt: What did John do for the marathon?
options: He asked a coach for help.
questions.translation: 约翰为马拉松做了什么准备？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“He practiced a lot, but on the race day, he felt worried.”可知，他刻苦进行了练习（He practiced hard）。答案为B。

questions.prompt: How did John feel when he saw a man running without shoes?
questions.translation: 当约翰看到一个不穿鞋跑步的男人时，他感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段最后一句“John was encouraged by the man, so he kept running.”可知，约翰受到了鼓舞（Encouraged）。答案为C。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word "beat" mean in Chinese?
questions.translation: 画线单词“beat”的中文意思是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段前句“John tried his best and ran past the man. He beat the man.”可知，约翰跑过了那个男人，即“打败/击败（beat）”了他。答案为A。

questions.prompt: Which of the following is TRUE?
options: John was excited before the marathon started.
John was worried about the man without shoes.
John's feet hurt, so he wanted to stop running.
John thought the man without shoes was amazing.
questions.translation: 以下哪项是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段约翰对那个男人说“You were amazing!”可知，约翰认为那个光脚跑的男人太了不起了。因此答案为D。

questions.prompt: What can we infer from the man's words in the last paragraph?
options: He ran a lot every day because of his job.
questions.translation: 从最后一段那个男人的话中我们可以推断出什么？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“I deliver pizzas every day. Running a marathon was easy for me!”可知，他每天送披萨跑很多路，因此跑马拉松对他来说很容易。答案为D。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 D
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
People in Zibo, Shandong, often see a 77-year-old woman playing basketball with great skills(技术). Her name is Li Xiurong, and she loves basketball. She has been playing basketball for more than ten years. Every day, she spends at least two hours playing on the basketball court (球场) in her community(社区).

Li's interest in basketball began when her grandson started playing it. She wanted to play with him, so she decided to give it a try. She quickly fell in love with the game, and even though her grandson has grown up, Li continues to play on the same court.

"At first, I played basketball for my grandson," Li said. "But now I find that it has become part of my life."

Playing basketball keeps Li healthy and happy. She thinks it helps her stay young and live a good life.

questions.prompt: When did Li Xiurong start to play basketball?
questions.translation: 李秀荣什么时候开始打篮球的？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“see a 77-year-old woman... She has been playing basketball for more than ten years.”可知，她现在77岁，打了十多年篮球，因此她是在60多岁（In her 60s）开始打的。答案为B。

questions.prompt: Li plays basketball on the court ________.
questions.translation: 李在 ________ 的球场上打篮球。
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“playing on the basketball court in her community”可知，是在她的社区（in her community）球场。答案为D。

questions.prompt: Why did Li decide to play basketball?
options: Her grandson asked her to do it.
She wanted to play with her grandson.
She dreamed about being a famous player.
She thought playing basketball would make her healthy.
questions.translation: 李为什么决定打篮球？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“She wanted to play with him, so she decided to give it a try.”可知，是因为她想和孙子一起玩。答案为B。

questions.prompt: What can we know from Paragraph 4?
options: Playing basketball is important to Li now.
Playing basketball now makes Li very tired.
Li's grandson doesn't like playing with her now.
Li's grandson is very healthy after playing basketball.
questions.translation: 从第四段中我们能知道什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段“Playing basketball keeps Li healthy and happy. She thinks it helps her stay young and live a good life.”可知，打篮球对她保持健康、快乐和年轻的生活非常重要。答案为A。

questions.prompt: Which is the best title for the passage?
options: A grandma's secret to being young
questions.translation: 这篇文章的最佳标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 全文讲述了77岁奶奶李秀荣热爱打篮球的故事，“A grandma's love for basketball（一位奶奶对篮球的热爱）”最贴合文章主题。答案为A。

sections.title: 二、任务型阅读
sections.instruction: 根据短文内容，从方框中所给的选项中选出能填入文中空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
### How to tell a good joke

Everyone loves to hear a good joke. At parties, people who can tell good jokes will be very popular. [1]

**Practice, practice, and practice!**
Tell your joke to as many people as you can, or even to the cat. [2]

**Be confident(自信的)!**
Don't begin by saying you can't tell jokes very well. And don't tell your audience(听众) how funny the joke is. This sometimes makes the joke less funny.

**Know your joke!**
Nothing is more terrible than forgetting your joke, or leaving out an important part, or forgetting the punchline(笑点). [3]

**Time it right!**
Speak clearly and confidently and try not to laugh. Don't hurry right into the next joke.

**Pay attention to your audience!**
Do they look interested, or bored, or puzzled? [4] Are they ready for the punchline now? [5] Then you know how to go on your joke.
wordbank: Make sure you can tell it well.
Here is some advice to help you become such a person.
So remember your jokes and don't make these mistakes(错误).

questions.translation: 这里有一些建议可以帮助你成为这样的人。
questions.explanation: 前句提到在聚会上会讲笑话的人很受欢迎，后文列出了讲笑话的几条具体建议，因此填入“这里有一些建议帮助你成为这样的人”引出下文，对应选项D。
questions.prompt: What is the best sentence to fill in blank [1]?
options: Make sure you can tell it well.
Here is some advice to help you become such a person.
So remember your jokes and don't make these mistakes(错误).

questions.translation: 确保你能讲好它。
questions.explanation: 该段主题是多练习（Practice），告诉大家多跟人或宠物练习讲笑话，最终目的是“确保自己能讲好它”，对应选项C。
questions.prompt: What is the best sentence to fill in blank [2]?
options: Make sure you can tell it well.
Here is some advice to help you become such a person.
So remember your jokes and don't make these mistakes(错误).

questions.translation: 所以记住你的笑话，不要犯这些错误。
questions.explanation: 前一句列举了忘词、遗漏重点或笑点等糟糕情况，总结句自然是“所以记住你的笑话，不要犯这些错误”，对应选项E。
questions.prompt: What is the best sentence to fill in blank [3]?
options: Make sure you can tell it well.
Here is some advice to help you become such a person.
So remember your jokes and don't make these mistakes(错误).

questions.translation: 他们跟得上你的故事节奏吗？
questions.explanation: 本段主题是关注听众（Pay attention to your audience），前一句问“他们看起来感兴趣、无聊还是困惑？”，后一句问“他们跟得上你的故事吗？”，排比提问听众反应，对应选项B。
questions.prompt: What is the best sentence to fill in blank [4]?
options: Make sure you can tell it well.
Here is some advice to help you become such a person.
So remember your jokes and don't make these mistakes(错误).

questions.translation: 那就开始讲你的笑话吧。
questions.explanation: 前一句问“他们准备好听笑点了么？”，后一句说“这样你就知道如何继续讲笑话了”，填入“开始讲你的笑话吧”衔接自然，对应选项A。
questions.prompt: What is the best sentence to fill in blank [5]?
options: Make sure you can tell it well.
Here is some advice to help you become such a person.
So remember your jokes and don't make these mistakes(错误).
